claim_boundary: A pinned 2024-2026 New Zealand public-results ledger, not an official live feed or a complete population census. Names, clubs, competition titles, and source IDs are removed from the local analytic table. Withdrawal rows and unflagged tied-score anomalies are retained for audit but excluded from predictive evaluation. The code repository is MIT, while underlying FeNZ result-data reuse rights were not independently verified; source rows and derivatives therefore remain local.
